notes.title: Capacity mechanics in our games
notes.notes: [p]If you take a closer look at the games we have released in the past and are currently working on, you will notice something in common. It is transportation and capacity control.[/p][p]We have been working on transport simulators for many years. For example, in Bus World, your task is to transport passengers safely and on time while driving a bus. If you create your own route in Free Mode, your task will also be to choose the right bus so that everyone fits. If the route is long and you decide to do it during rush hours, then obviously it is better to choose a large, spacious bus. After all, if you choose a small one, not all passengers will fit in it. But for a short or night trip, a small bus would be more suitable, because it consumes less fuel, which costs money.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1193090/Bus_World/"][/dynamiclink]We decided to implement an economy based on capacity in one of the monthly modes in the American Dream DLC for Fly Corp. In it, planes spend money on fuel when departing from an airport, so flying half-empty or with almost no passengers is extremely unprofitable. You can lose more than you earn.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3285860/Fly_Corp__American_Dream/"][/dynamiclink]In the classic Fly Corp modes, you constantly have to keep an eye on the capacity of airports and planes and carefully organize transfer hubs.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1372530/Fly_Corp/"][/dynamiclink]Check Inn, a game about building hotels and checking guests in, also features capacity logic. Guests arrive in waves, and our task is to build rooms according to their wishes. The faster we check in a guest, the higher the rating we receive. The faster they are served by service rooms (kitchen, laundry, sauna, etc.), the faster they will leave the hotel. In the game, we monitor the hotel's capacity and make sure there is always enough space for everyone. That's why Check Inn, even though it doesn't look like it, gives a gaming experience similar to Fly Corp. By the way, Check Inn will be leaving early access and going into full release next month. So we are really looking forward to your feedback on the game.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2741390/Check_Inn/"][/dynamiclink]At the same time, we have already started working on our next game, which will also have the word Corp in its title, and the idea of capacity control will also play a key role in it. We can't say more at this point, but the announcement of this game will most likely take place before the end of this year.[/p][p]The idea of capacity control has been present in our games for a long time and will be used again in new projects, in its best form. We strive to continue making games that can provide dozens, or even hundreds, of enjoyable hours.[/p][p]Thank you for staying with us! Stay tuned for news, because very soon we will show you something new![/p]

notes.title: Accurate and optimized route search - meet the 1.5.1 update!
notes.notes:
Previously, for optimization, we used a pathfinding algorithm with an approximate calculation of the optimal route. This means that in complex situations, the algorithm gave close to optimal, but not the most optimal routes. We have long been trying to improve the path search algorithm to increase its accuracy and performance. This is a truly non-trivial task. And now, finally, we have succeeded.

[b]Now passengers should choose the most optimal route[/b] from the departure city to the final destination city for transfers. At the same time, you should be able to see [b]improved performance[/b] of the game.

Also in this version:
- Fixed a bug when in some rare cases the statistics screen showed more territories than were actually unlocked
- Fixed a bug where passengers could try travelling to a city that was not yet connected
- Fixed a problem with city names in the tutorial when switching languages from the pause menu

This was the case - route finding in complex situations, when there are many open cities and connections between them, gave approximate, close to optimal routes. We have been trying to improve the route finding algorithm for a long time to increase its accuracy and performance. This is really a non-trivial task. And now, finally, we are ready to present an improved version for your judgment.

[b]What changes should you notice?[/b]

As noted above - look at complex situations, when there are a lot of routes between cities. [b]Now passengers should choose the most optimal possible route[/b] for transfers from the departure city to the final destination city.

At the same time, [b]performance should improve[/b]. Therefore, if you have experienced problems with the game slowing down earlier, please share how much better it has become for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/bbf6c89ecd1564d1b6e8117bcfa4d451c5cf1809.jpg[/img]

However, to ensure high performance, some [b]compromises[/b] had to be made. We set a limit of 100 cities per territory and a minimum distance of 100 kilometers between cities for [i][b]new[/b][/i] scenarios created in the scenario editor. Please note that the [i][b]new limits will not affect old scenarios created on previous versions of the game.[/b][/i]

[b]How to join the beta?[/b]

[b]We are starting testing in a closed branch of Steam (Windows version only!).[/b] To switch to the testing branch on Steam, find the game in your library, right-click and select "Properties" from the context menu. [b]Warning![/b] Do not forget to switch back to the default branch after you finish exploring the test branch, otherwise you will not receive game updates in the future, which are published in the general branch.

As always, we are looking forward to your feedback! Enjoy your flights!✈️

notes.title: Our plans for this Fall
notes.notes:
Today we will share our plans: what we are going to work on in the coming months. As always, we would like to hear your opinion on these ideas.

[h3]New monthly game modes[/h3]

Currently, the game has daily scenarios, but of course there is not an infinite number of them and after some time they inevitably repeat. We would like to add variety by adding monthly modes to the game (that is, those that are available for one month and then change to another one). For example:
- A game mode in which passengers from everywhere want to fly to one specific city. This city is selected every N minutes, so you will constantly have to monitor the altering direction of the passenger flow.
- A game mode in which new cities can be unlocked by the player themselves. There are two options (we have not yet come up with which one is more interesting, but we may implement both): a random city opens when the player presses a button; the player themselves selects from a bunch of cities on the map (marked in muted gray) the one they want to include in the game, and only after that passengers will start gathering there.
- Speedrun. A variation of "Discover the World", but the main task will be to complete it in time. Accordingly, the main parameter in the leaderboard will be completion time, not the number of points scored.

These are just some of our ideas regarding monthly game modes. If players especially like one of them, we will make it available on a permanent basis or repeat it as part of the monthly schedule.

We also plan to work on optimizing the game and improving pathfinding algorithms. In fact, both tasks are intertwined and require an integrated approach. Such improvements can take many months of hard work, so we are not ready to name exact ETAs yet.

[h3]DLC with the United States of America[/h3]

We expect to make a DLC dedicated to the USA as a separate product. Firstly, this is logical, since it will be necessary to create a separate map, scenarios, balance and change the logic of some game processes. Secondly, this way we will get financial opportunities to further support the game (see the above-described new modes and work on optimization/improvement of algorithms).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/710a6bcd0a057afb5d2c9351aac6085f1e5cde40.png[/img]
[h3]What to expect from the expansion?[/h3]

We would like to implement the ability to unlock each existing state, and make a unique visual representation of each of them. Probably, we will also have to rework the parameters of the aircraft capacity (and maybe even add helicopters?), change the balance of the game in general. As in the original game, we would like to have both the "Unlock all States" mode and Scenarios in which various unusual situations would be played out.

[b]It is important for us to know your opinion. What do you think about the above plans?[/b] Please write your comments: we read all of them, and, if necessary, try to respond. You can also discuss the news on our Discord server: http://discord.gg/invite/9eHyYap

We completely rebalanced both modes. We did not like the way the cost of tickets was calculated before as it was somewhat chaotic. Now, this value changes smoothly.

Next, a little about how the calculations happen "under the hood". The more territories are unlocked, the more the costs of supporting the infrastructure are. This is reflected in the ticket price. For example, for delivering a passenger from point A to point B, when 1 territory is unlocked, you get a little more than when 10 territories are unlocked. However, in general, due to the constantly increasing passenger flow, you still earn more and more money in total. If we did not change the ticket price, the amount earned would quickly exceed all conceivable limits - hundreds of trillions.

The cost of unlocking new territories and the cost of creating routes at later stages of the game were reduced. Now the numbers are more convenient to operate.

The first scenario, in which the balance periodically goes into the negative, was too easy. Now it can be classified as a medium-difficulty scenario.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/8f4ac636139d862c8560ef9a0043069f6be6f1f1.png[/img]

notes.title: Reviewing three interesting scenarios of the last month
notes.notes:
While we're working on the next update, community presents more and more interesting scenarios!

Let us remind you that our game has a scenario editor and the ability to upload your scenario to the server. At the moment, almost 2.500 scenarios have been published even despite the fact that we periodically purge the worst ones that have no value for players.

Let's look at three scenarios that caught our attention this month.

The first scenario is 4 Corners by KMS. We start in Canada with quite a big amount of money and the game instantly asks us whether we want to get rid of first level airports and airplanes. We advise you to do so right now because it will definitely help us in the future. At the same time, we see that the scenario is quite long as we need to survive for 60 minutes. And quite soon we understand why our initial amount of money is quite large: the next country that unlocks automatically after a minute is Argentina, located thousands of kilometers away from Canada. As we progress, New Zealand and Russia are unlocked. As you may've already guessed, the scenario is named 4 Corners because the only countries that you are operating in are the countries situated in the four corners of the game map. However, you should not only pay attention to long-distance flights as cities are progressively unlocking in each of countries, so short flights are as important.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/4bf2c2bbfaab39790dd56556a9298eadb6f922be.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/4c708f5573eecbedf38a74fd07e6d54732527758.png[/img]

In the next scenario called Connect 100 cities in SEA by Geography, we'll help the ASEAN region to develop a modern airline network. The goal is the same as in previous scenario - we'll have to survive for 60 minutes. The specific thing here is that Asian countries have very high passenger flow, and sometimes you'll have to react rapidly to certain changes or events.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/f40afca8bf80deafa7a3881782ed9924388f0507.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/4105060fa9a4835e105febf2e71e76e1f944bf0c.png[/img]

The final today's scenario is called Europe from A to UK and is made by CVDB. Here we'll need to unlock all countries of Europe in alphabetical order, starting from Albania, a small country with 5 available cities. Earning money is a really hard task at first, but this is compensated by more than 2 hours that are given to you to complete the scenario. Countries are unlocked automatically over time, so your primary task is to keep an eye on your hubs and flights, and prevent the situation from spiraling out of control.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/439bc98691eca94bb785de9b243d413145b64919.png[/img]

You can find these scenarios in the game, in Custom Scenarios. Convenient search is available there, available for look either by scenario name or by author's name.

notes.title: Fly Corp has been released from Early Access!
notes.notes:
[h1]Today is the day when Fly Corp leaves the Early Access stage of development![/h1]

[h2]How the game has been developed[/h2]

Let’s take a look back in time and recall how we developed Fly Corp.

The idea of such game and very first versions appeared back in 2019, when we didn’t even know how many things we are going to add to the game. The whole initial idea was only about one game mode, but each month of development gave us a quite clear clue that we are actually working on a quite interesting and distinctive minimalist strategy. We had more and more ideas which were implemented sooner or later.

In 2021, the game finally saw Early Access release. The first public version already had both scenarios and Discover the World mode (by the way, the last one was unbeatable, and the whole competition was about the number of unlocked territories). We started to receive lots of useful feedback from you, and some of your ideas found their way into the game. We figured out that some players didn’t want to constantly compete with others. Rather, they just wanted to build their transport network. This is how Free Mode appeared, where you can’t lose because of an airport being overloaded.

Visuals have also seen many changes. Step by step, we made user interface more convenient, and game map - more appealing to look at. Random events got accompanied by corresponding pictures.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/614c623d5f85ad0075dbc6b270b48a52aedde9cc.png[/img]
There were some large updates as well. Scenario editor was added, allowing players to create scenarios with their own conditions and specifications. Each day had a new scenario for players, where they can compete with others in the Leaderboard. Daily Scenarios breathed even more live into the game. We’d also like to thank our players who created and shared interesting scenarios - some of them made their way to Daily Mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/1b27ca798246e987117d2dcfac4f08e363bc0da0.png[/img]
And now, when the game goes into the full-fledged release stage, we are happy to present to you the next stage of Fly Corp’s life.

[h2]The epic release update[/h2]

Now, each player can upload their scenario to the server, into the general scenario list. Everyone is free to open Custom Scenarios and dive into the stories created by other players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/ae546beb48d749ce0b872633da5bebb9700e88ac.png[/img]
Together with today’s update, we brought many other minor changes to the game.

We already have some important updates planned for the future. We’ll keep making the game better for you after the release.

[h2]***[/h2]

We’d like to say a huge “Thank You” to all players who’ve been following the project for all this time. We welcome new players and invite all of you to a fascinating world of passenger transportations and to cozy community in our social media!

Complete 5 scenarios from the public listing that are made by other players.

"Scenario expert"

"A big luck"
Get three supersonic jets in one game.

"Maximum upgrade"

notes.title: Progress in game optimization!
notes.notes:
We noticed that most of the negative feedback is based on low performance in some situations. Indeed, performance drops when player unlocks really many cities and spawns hundreds of planes (it's noticeable only in Free Mode - it's almost impossible to spawn that many planes in other modes). We are working on fixing this problem, in particular we are optimizing algorithm of calculating plane's position on the map and generating passengers in airports.

[previewyoutube=B1AH_A6RZ4w;full][/previewyoutube]

The work is still not done, but you can already see the first results - hundreds of planes and stable 60 frames per second! At the same time, we are refactoring code that launches different game modes, loads and saves the game. In the future, it will allow us to work on the game more effectively and will fix dozens of bugs.

notes.title: We have released a new update
notes.notes:
We have released a small update.

We altered the mechanism of counting your score after completing time-limited challenges (Unlock N countries and get N credits for the certain period of time). We added a new coefficient for the final player's count. Earlier, players didn't have the necessity to hurry up, and it was more profitable to play to the final point when the time was almost up. Now, the faster you complete the challenge, the bigger is the multiplier (starting at 0% and finishing with 100%). For example, if you need to unlock 5 countries for 10 minutes and you did it for 9 minutes, the remaining time (1 minute) is 10% from this time, meaning that your final score will be multiplied by 10%, which is 1,1.

notes.title: Update 03 Feb 2022 and plans for the future!
notes.notes:
Hello, dear players!
In this post we'll tell you about what was fixed in today's patch and what's being worked on right now. From time to time, we see comments from people complaining that updates aren't released as frequently as they would like. We agree, but the game has been worked on every single day.

So, here's what we fixed in today's update:
- Fixed a bug which caused level 2 planes and airports to remain at level 2 after restart (if random event about upgraded planes or airport was triggered);
- Fixed bug with removing routes to or from blocked city;
- Fixed bug when money wasn't added to your balance after the event in which you get money and 3 cities are unlocked instantly;
- Fixed translations of reduced passenger flow event. Fixed logics of "Yes/No" choice in this event;
- Fixed font size of newly unlocked cities;
- Other minor fixes.

Why updates are worked on for more time than we planned? As we told before, Fly Corp is being developed since Summer of 2019. Initially, it was a strictly experimental product - we haven't developed anything like this before. But, the more work we put into this game, the more confidence we had that we were doing everything the right way. But, newer versions inherited the code of bad quality from earlier versions, and we had to maintain this code. Now we're working on re-writing it along with fixing bugs. As a part of this effort, random events system was made almost from scratch. We plan to support Fly Corp for a long time, and this is why it's very important to bring it into a good state under the hood so that it will become easier to develop the game.

Here are some recent news:
1. Finally, all the pictures for random events are finished! As always, we're publishing some of them for you to take a look. Now our task is to implement them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/714c37208a25641a7505236b42ea1392b34d58f3.jpg[/img]

2. We're working on releasing Challenge Editor Beta. We promised to release it in 2021, but everything is much more difficult than we thought. But we're still actively working on it. We don't want to talk about the date in order not to accidentally tell you something that is not true.
3. We're reading your bug reports and are taking notes of some problems of the game. For example, we're thinking on ways of improving logics of negative events right after the game starts. Now, in rare cases, in Unlock All Countries mode, player can lose the game just because there was an unfortunate set of events.

Also, we have more thoughts about the next versions of the game, and we'd like to speak with you about some ideas. We'll tell you more about that later.

Thanks for staying with us and playing Fly Corp!

notes.title: A detailed look at Challenge Editor in Fly Corp
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello everyone![/h3]

Today we’d like to tell you about an interesting feature which will become available for everyone in the end of this summer, and it’s called Challenge Editor.

We have information about several tens of thousands of cities around the world in our game, and we can use any of them while creating challenges. Each one is unique in a way that affects gameplay – distance to other cities and population (passenger flow depends on it). Some cities have their own random events: for example, a game exhibition can take place in Cologne and Los Angeles, and Octoberfest may begin in München. These events temporarily increase passenger flow to these cities.
Let us show how the editor works.

Let’s try to create a simple challenge about flights in USA to far cities. It would be quite expensive to build far routes – this is going to be the main challenge for player.
Interface of this editor is about to change as this is a very early look.

The first tab: we need to enter the name and description of our challenge. What is interesting – you can enter these on English and other languages supported by the game. The language selected in Settings will be chosen by default.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/4a1905b2ba2fb22c7dda0a271282e13011c90588.jpg[/img]
 
The second screen is a lot more complex and contains many parameters which will determine, what will happen in the challenge. First of all, let’s add victory condition. Let it be: “Gather 30000 credits in 20 minutes”. On the same screen, let’s make Initial balance to 1000. It would be enough to connect the first few cities, upgrade a plane or launch a couple of new ones.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/0d6e2e4a53b5cd848c167d46dac3721e769f5504.jpg[/img]
 
From time to time, random events can occur in the game, affecting the gameplay. Here you can choose how often they will occur or disable them fully. Also, here you can set the minimum population of an unlocked city. If population of the city is lower than this number, it won’t unlock in the challenge.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/1e5a782dc1923d37686d4dbd076097b989a312bc.jpg[/img]
 
The percentage of domestic routes determines how many passengers will fly only inside the country. In our scenario, there is only one country – USA, so let’s not touch it now – it won’t affect anything. Let’s assign interval between unlocking cities (they will be chosen randomly), and how quick new passengers will appear in airports.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/5a81151e1422b6bc3fd795b43f98d96f3e411ebb.jpg[/img]
 
The initial country is, of course, the USA. Let’s add the rule which won’t allow players to unlock other countries (other possible options: unlock any countries; unlock countries which have a common border with currently unlocked ones).
Let’s leave speed of the basic 1st level plane as is (but we can dramatically change game speed just my adjusting it).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/912e73eab6316044521c79104e1da9e39c57e094.jpg[/img]
 
Here’s a game mechanic hidden from player: passenger flow generated by a city grows over time. After the determined time, passenger flow is increased twice. But the cities are unlocked gradually, so passenger flow grows very fluently in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/abad016373ffb85ecf81ec79f951216f87a001d5.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/870e04349986e955cd063acb83ef01b9ac989c19.jpg[/img]
  
Now let’s pay our attention to the third tab. It’s Timeline, and it determines what will happen in the game during the challenge. Let’s click on it and add two cities to be unlocked at the start – we’ll connect them to the capital.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/12ca947a5f2bd8ffbdfa11d4c0d78caa1c3766f3.jpg[/img]
 
Let’s create one more event: unlock Seattle City on the seventh minute of gameplay. Pay attention to the number in brackets – it’s population of this city, and as you remember, it influences the passenger flow into and from it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/2199a279513c691207cd9a03efe8b1c65d4d8408.jpg[/img]
 
Now let’s add a couple of cities distant from the central part of the country:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/bc02c65528b71b4f9f958ba3d1310c2414de5caf.jpg[/img]
 
Let’s make our own event! According to our evil plan, player would have to pay taxes on the eighth minute. To do that, we add events “Subtract money” and “Show message” (so that the player knows the reason why his balance decreased).
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/8819af358fc2af5a88eb034395c3cdb362e40643.jpg[/img] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/40b1cde0b1e9bc71171b27e5fea0806bd0298853.jpg[/img]

You can also add pre-set events like volcano eruption, pandemics, global crisis and others. All of them will affect gameplay in this or that way.
Finally, let’s give name to the challenge file and test it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/e978ed29d070e2442fc92101374530f01c007146.jpg[/img]
 
By default, we only have capital and two cities we chose on the timeline. After 1,5 minutes, just like we entered, a random city was unlocked – New York, After 1,5 more minutes – Chicago. Now we can connect them and begin building our network.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/444b158a648b8b1a47a6879e4d88d05fb6500e4c.jpg[/img]
 
The cities are unlocked constantly. Here’s the Seattle! Let’s build a route by connecting it with Albuquerque.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/ebd0ba2c32ea7cd04bcf256a78c82bc539e4a435.jpg[/img]
 
The time passes, new routes are being built, new planes are bought. Despite these costs, we still earn money. We need to save as much as we can to connect Alaska and Hawaii to our network, just like we stated on the Timeline.
We believe that challenge editor will drastically change the game and make it more replayable. After that, we’d like to implement the database of user-created challenges with search, ratings etc.
As for right now – the game has quite many pre-created challenges – all of them are created in this editor and you can try them right now.
Thank you for attention, have a nice flight!

Population of every city is considered by the game. The more is the population, the faster is the fill-up speed for the corresponding airport. You'll need to consider that while planning new routes. notes.title: Fly Corp official announcement
notes.notes:
We present you our new game, [b]Fly Corp[/b], for PCs and mobile devices! It is a minimalistic transport strategy about [b]planes[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/3bd3b7a6b8e92280701377f7bda384c4d95ce01c.png[/img]

The game is being actively developed, but you can [b]try[/b] the demo version for PCs right now [b]for free[/b]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1372530

Despite the quite minimalistic look of the game, we've been doing our best to make the gameplay deep and involving while keeping the controls simple and easy to use.

[h3]So, what this game is?[/h3]
You're about to develop your own airline transport network in various cities and countries by creating routes, buying new planes, upgrading airports and airplanes. The game features an advanced passenger flow system. All cities are real, and their population corresponds with reality. The more the population is, the higher is the number of people who want to fly somewhere. Every passenger has their destination point and, if no direct route is available, he would fly with changes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/401d8e5539630b4f955a2ae2812eaca48c3c0600.png[/img]

There are [b]several game modes[/b] now.
Your task in [i][b]Unlock all Countries[/b][/i] mode is to unlock all the countries of the world by buying them for in-game money and to cover the whole planet with your network. You'll have to unlock a new country every 6 minutes in order not to loose. In [i][b]Challenges[/b][/i] mode, different scenarios with pre-set conditions and targets are waiting for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/c2506b1ecb1f208a81556ba59cee3bc344109d0e.jpg[/img]

[b]Try[/b] the demo on Steam [b]for free[/b] right now! Also, don't forget the game to your [b]Wishlist[/b] on Steam and join our social network groups so that you won't miss any news!

[b]Our group on Facebook[/b]: https://www.facebook.com/KishMishGames/

The full version is planned to be released in a few months.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/d4d9f311646a1e1ebbd18d9e30895800a29839f7.png[/img]

[b]P.S.[/b] The work on Bus Driver Simulator, Bus World and Metro Simulator has been going as it did before. Fly Corp is worked on by a small separate mini-department, which is not connected to simulation games. It means that you don't need to care about updates of your favorite games - they will release just like usual, and Fly Corp development isn't a problem for that.
